# INSIGNAR

> INSIGNAR is B2B introduction and follow-up software for UK teams. After an in-person conversation, the rep records what the person said. INSIGNAR builds a private page about that person's problem, which they open by tapping a numbered NFC / QR card (no app needed). The page ends in one action, booking a meeting, and has a small chat for questions. The rep sees what each person opened and asked. It is not a digital business card. Stage: pre-launch, with a UK founding pilot by request. There are no customers, reviews or ratings yet.
